summary: Fast-to-slow clock pulses require toggle-handshake logic, not direct 2-FF synchronizers.
hardware_rationale: If destination clock period T_dst > source pulse width T_src, the pulse can assert and deassert between sampling edges, causing silent command loss.
anti_pattern_snippet: always_ff @(posedge clkB) begin q1 <= cmd_pulse_clkA; q2 <= q1; end

canary_spec.bad_canary_sv: module bad (input clkA, clkB, rst_n, in_p, output out_p); reg s1, s2; always_ff @(posedge clkB) {out_p, s1} <= {s1, in_p}; endmodule
canary_spec.good_canary_sv: module good (input clkA, clkB, rst_n, in_p, output out_p); reg t, s1, s2, s3; always_ff @(posedge clkA) if (in_p) t <= ~t; always_ff @(posedge clkB) {s3, s2, s1} <= {s2, s1, t}; assign out_p = s2 ^ s3; endmodule
